defect: a same-cycle register transfer is granted two cycles without a protocol enable
rationale: result_o captures next_count on every active clk_i edge, so the count_q-to-result_o transfer is not a two-cycle protocol. The ordinary en_i update control does not justify a multicycle timing exception.

mutation.description: Added a two-cycle multicycle exception for the count_q-to-result_o path without an enable that holds the destination.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the enabled counter datapath and clocked result update; removed the wrapped delta counter and overflow interface.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: result_o samples next_count (from count_q plus d_i) every cycle with no stall, so the 2-cycle multicycle is unearned.
